Dear [Miss Cole](../persons.html#326)[^1]				
I am much obliged for your book which I am sure I shall read with much interest as the fruit of so many thoughts
I hear from [Mrs Montgomery Moore](../persons.html#1042) from [Rawal Pindee ](../others.html#262)which at least is near that beautiful Cashmere though she never will be happy in India.
[Elizabeth](../persons.html#320) is at Dittisham[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Another letter exists, evidently to the same Miss Cole who was a friend of the Colborne family, dated 17 March [1860s?].

On the evidence of this letter, she may have been Nina Cole, author of Meditations on the Song of Songs (1874), a volume edited by the Rev.

George Cosby White.

[^2]: The Rector of Dittisham was the Rev. and Hon.

Graham Colborne, brother of Jane Montgomery Moore and Elizabeth Colborne.
